📚Build a Study Schedule That Actually Works 1. Count the weeks until your exam, then divide your syllabus across those weeks. Know your pace. 2. Build buffer weeks into your schedule — life happens. Flexible plans survive, rigid ones collapse. 3. Assign subjects to specific days: don't try to cover all subjects daily. Batch by subject for depth. 4. Schedule review sessions BEFORE new content — start each week by reviewing the previous week first. 5. Your peak energy hours should be reserved for hardest subjects. Schedule light review for low-energy times. 6. Review your study schedule every Sunday. What worked? What didn't? This is a MAJOR red flag in my book 🚩🚩 Check out my other CF creator friends: @Sam McGraw 🐶 @angelina rivera 🧚🏼‍♀️✨ @Grace | cruelty-free 🐰 @Jess | veganbeautyaddict @Hales  #charlottetilbury #boycott #animaltesting #crueltyfree

Bye, Darling. No more @Charlotte Tilbury for the cruelty-free community.  THE TEA: Charlotte Tilbury has now publicly announced on their website they will not be renewing their Cruelty Free International certification.  THE BACKSTORY: Cruelty Free International (previously also referred to as The Leaping Bunny Programme) is the international coalition partner to Leaping Bunny (who certified North America). They recently announced a rebrand with a new logo. Both programs remain coalition partners with the same rigorous program, just certifying different regions.  THE WHY:  Allegedly, they are concerned about the public perception of this rebrand and its potential to cause confusion  THE ISSUE: 1. Charlotte Tilbury never has to print the rebranded logo on their packaging if they find the new logo from the previous bunny confusing. If they can write the giant chunk of text as their cruelty-free policy they recently revised, then they could have just as easily explained the rebrand and continued commitment.  2. Charlotte Tilbury now claims to be cruelty-free with zero audits, annual renewals, and is left unchecked selling on China where the brand could potentially begin selling their special use goods (which are subject to animal testing) in China. We are just expected to trust them.  3. Charlotte Tilbury is owned by parent company Puig with a large portfolio of other major brands all subject to animal testing as well. CT was the only cruelty-free brand in their collection. It makes this move extra questionable.  Shoutout and thanks to my friends @angelina rivera 🧚🏼‍♀️✨ @Sam McGraw 🐶 @Eli Levi for also jumping on this and their commentary/thoughts as well. 📚Remember Anything With These Tricks 1. Mnemonics: create an acronym or silly phrase using the first letters of a list you need to memorize. 2. The Memory Palace: visualize walking through your house and 'placing' facts in specific rooms. 3. Rhymes and songs make information sticky — set boring content to a tune and it becomes unforgettable. 4. Association: link new information to something you already know well. New knowledge needs an anchor. 5. Repetition with variation: say it, write it, draw it, teach it. Four formats = four times the retention. 6. The weirder your memory trick, the more effective it is. Bizarre associations are impossible to forget. #StudyTok #StudyMotivation #ExamPrep #StudyHacks #StudyWithMe

#mascara                                    Un mascara est un produit de maquillage destiné à être appliqué sur les cils afin de les allonger, les épaissir, les recourber et intensifier le regard. Il se présente généralement sous forme liquide ou crémeuse, contenu dans un tube avec une brosse applicatrice. Le mascara permet de donner plus de volume et de définition aux cils en les colorant, le plus souvent en noir, mais aussi en brun ou en couleurs plus originales. Selon sa formule et la forme de la brosse, il peut offrir différents effets : naturel, volumineux, allongeant ou recourbant.
